description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'XliffFileProcessFailedException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Exception' namespace, used for handling specific errors related to XLIFF file processing.

classes.name: XliffFileProcessFailedException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends PHP's base Exception class, providing static methods to generate specific exception instances related to XLIFF file validation errors.

methods.name: validationFailed
methods.description: Returns an instance of XliffFileProcessFailedException indicating that the XLIFF file is invalid.

methods.name: emptyFile
methods.description: Returns an instance of XliffFileProcessFailedException indicating that the XLIFF file is empty.

methods.name: missingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Returns an instance of XliffFileProcessFailedException indicating that the target language attribute is missing from the XLIFF file.

methods.name: invalidTargetLanguage
methods.description: Returns an instance of XliffFileProcessFailedException indicating that the target language in the XLIFF file does not match the expected language.
